 Add a claude account

 What kind of login?

 > short
     A login rota refreshes; usage readings and Remote Control need it.
   long
     A year, inference only: no usage readings or Remote Control. Two
     approvals: the login that makes the account, then the year-long token.
   API key
     A Claude Console key, paid per token: no usage readings or Remote Control;
     it starts out of the rotation.
----
 Sign claude account 12 (a@x) in again

 What kind of login?

 > short
     A login rota refreshes, which only this account's approval finishes; usage
     readings and Remote Control need it.
   long
     A year, inference only: no usage readings or Remote Control. The token
     goes on whichever account approves it.
   setup token
     A token `claude setup-token` printed, pasted: a year, inference only, on
     this account.
----
 Sign claude account 12 (a@x) in again

 Open this and approve access as a@x, which is claude account 12; no other
 account's approval will finish it:

   https://claude.example/oauth/authorize?code=true&client_id=c&state=s

   ⏎ send  esc leave the field

 code   WRONG                                                          15m left
        authorization code was rejected (expired, already used, or mismatched):
        Invalid authorization code; try the code again, or approve again at the
        same link
